source_lock.policy: Exact Git tree (paths and blob IDs); refuses dirty engine sources

approval_policy: Hash-bound approvals require reviewer, language_ok and complete row digest. No approval is inferred from old packets.
target_scope: Final accepted room requests after the complete conversation; not a per-turn operation alignment claim.

editorial_refresh.method: Verified body hashes + current-source exact request/result replay; only messages and source document hashes refreshed.

split_policy: Frozen existing source assignments; new source groups use stable 80/10/10 hash buckets. Cross-partition bridges fail.

arabic_append.method: Exact source document hashes and unchanged complete engine source tree verified; new records have no operations or plans.
